title: JSON Schema builder
description: Meta-schema for defining editable JSON schemas with UI layout controls, custom input widgets, and conditional display logic. Extends standard JSON Schema with MediaWiki-specific widget configurations and layout options.

classes.description: The names of the CSS classes to apply to the element

help.description: Help text. When help text is specified and helpInline is false, a "help" icon will appear in the upper-right corner of the rendered field; clicking it will display the text in a popup. If helpInline is true, then a subtle description will be shown after the label.

helpInline.description: Whether or not the help should be inline, or shown when the "help" icon is clicked

id.description: The HTML id attribute used in the rendered tag

invisibleLabel.description: Whether the label should be visually hidden (but still accessible to screen-readers)

x-label-template.description: label template (overrides label, usually used in conjunction with x-watch)

uiSchemaItem.description: Defines a UI schema configuration for adding dynamic properties to objects.

oneOf.title: reference
oneOf.description: Internal or external reference to the JSON schema definition

baseProperties.description: Base JSON Schema keywords common to all schema types (excluding multiple-related keywords)

const.description: The value must be equal to this constant

type.description: JSON Schema primitive type (string, number, integer, boolean, object, array, null)

description.description: Description or help text for the field

x-title-template.description: title template (overrides title, usually used in conjunction with x-watch)

x-description-template.description: description template (overrides description, usually used in conjunction with x-watch)

$comment.description: Developer comment - ignored by validation, for documentation purposes

x-message.label: Reference to another schema (eg. #definitions/subschema, or JsonSchema:SubSchema, or JsonSchema:SubSchema#definitions/sub-subschema)

deprecated.description: Field is deprecated - show warning to users

enum.description: The value must be one of these specified values

examples.description: Example values demonstrating valid input (not validation keywords)

readOnly.description: Field is read-only and cannot be modified

writeOnly.description: Field can be written but not read (e.g., password fields)

x-runtime-only.description: Field only used at runtime (e.g., pagename formula)

x-watch.description: Watched fields for reactive updates. Can be an array of fields, or key/value pairs mapping alias to field name.

x-hidden.description: Hide the field from the form UI

x-compact.description: Hide title, description and error holder, disable border and padding

x-css-class.description: Custom CSS class name to apply to the container

x-css-inline.description: Inline css to apply to the container

x-dependency.description: Conditional display logic - field only shown when dependencies are met

x-required.description: Set the property as required (it will be handled within the "required" property in the parent schema)

x-data.description: Data object to be used in conjunction with converters or enum providers

multiple.description: Schema for logical combinations (oneOf, anyOf, allOf, not, if/then/else). Matches when type is NOT set.

oneOf.description: Schema must be valid against exactly one of the subschemas (logical XOR)

allOf.description: Schema must be valid against all of the subschemas (logical AND)

anyOf.description: Schema must be valid against at least one of the subschemas (logical OR)

not.description: Schema must NOT be valid against the given schema

if.description: Conditional validation: if this schema validates, then 'then' must validate

then.description: Conditional validation: must validate when 'if' validates

else.description: Conditional validation: must validate when 'if' does NOT validate

properties.description: Explicitly defined object properties with their schemas

x-switch-config.description: Configuration options passed to the selected input widget

default.description: Default string value when not provided

x-enum-titles.description: Display labels for enum values. Must be the same length as enum array.

x-enum-template.description: Dynamic source for enum using templates

x-enum-provider.description: Name of the enum provider to be used in selects. When not a built-in function, must be declared in [[MediaWiki:DefaultEditorOptions]] and provide at least a "source" method

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern that the string must match

x-pattern-message.description: User-friendly error message to show when pattern validation fails

x-template.description: Template string for generating dynamic values (e.g., '{{field1}}-{{field2}}')
